findings.evidence: First/middle/last physical-close RuntimeError followed by local errors.append MemoryError leaves ledger.unknown_close false. Phase callbacks proceed to ACTUAL_READY before and after SOURCE_APPROVED. First/middle additionally skip later owner closes; last leaves the failed-close virtual handle/ledger owner.
findings.remediation: Latch unknown-close before all fallible error recording. Guard secondary error bookkeeping so it cannot interrupt later owned close attempts. Preserve the original exception chain and do not retry an unknown descriptor.
findings.title: Error-buffer failure precedes the unknown-close latch

findings.remediation: Continue every detached owner after any bookkeeping BaseException. Keep known successful physical closes distinct from unknown close state; attempt each owner exactly once and preserve error context.
findings.title: Secondary error-buffer failure abandons remaining owners
